{{Quote|Never underestimate the power of the Dark Virus!|Text from e-mail carrying the Dark Virus|<ref name="Star Wars: X-Wing Alliance">''[[Star Wars: X-Wing Alliance]]''</ref>}}
The '''Dark Virus''' was a [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] [[E-mail|electronic mail]] virus that infected [[Ace Azzameen/Legends|Ace Azzameen's]] transmission in [[3 ABY/Legends|3 ABY]]. [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Alliance]] security officer [[D. Wolren]] warned Rebel e-mail users to look out for the virus, which was delivered in messages titled "Need your help!" and sent from "A Friend". The virus could delete all e-mail messages in an infected [[Computer/Legends|computer]] system.
